checkpoint_metrics: fraction of 48 observed triples with all three role completions correct
per-tensor and total parameter L2 norms
information_exposure: Production execution with the complete curated Issue-015.03 packet: 84 opaque Event IDs, 48 TRAIN records, and 96 evaluation-only ROLE_TEST records. No NOVEL_TEST data, Issue 016 content, SFP/Fano/habitat coordinates, or certified completion tables were accessed. Optimizer calibration received TRAIN records only.

interpretation_bins.R0: NO-COMMON-CAPACITY: matched comparison unavailable; report only capacity diagnostics
interpretation_bins.R1: neither arm has >=7/8 seeds reaching t_role95: this score family does not yield robust ROLE transfer; exact role symmetry alone is insufficient here
interpretation_bins.R2: Arm T has >=7/8 seeds reaching t_role95 and Arm D has <7/8: role-neutral triad score constitution is sufficient relative to the matched directional scorer for robust seen-triad consequence
interpretation_bins.R3: both arms have >=7/8 seeds reaching t_role95: the matched scalar-scoring family succeeds, but the experiment does not isolate role symmetry as the decisive cause
interpretation_bins.R4: Arm D has >=7/8 seeds reaching t_role95 and Arm T has <7/8: role symmetry is not beneficial in this setup

metric_definitions.embedding_effective_rank: exp(-sum_i p_i log p_i)), p_i=s_i^2/sum_j s_j^2 for the 64 singular values of the 84x64 Event embedding
metric_definitions.margin_median: ordinary sample median (mean of middle two for n=96)
metric_definitions.role_margin: correct score minus maximum other legal-candidate score

scientific_fences: No discovery or evaluation of the global 56-block relation.
No NOVEL blocks or NOVEL metric.
No claim for a preferred OT learning law.
No claim that Event embeddings contain a unique readable algebra.
No claim that every consequence-learning problem reduces to permutation invariance.
No language-scale, physical Event, or physical Outcome semantics claim.

temporal_definitions.t_fit: first scheduled checkpoint with TRAIN accuracy == 1.0
temporal_definitions.t_role95: first scheduled checkpoint with ROLE_TEST accuracy >= 0.95 at that checkpoint and the next two scheduled checkpoints
temporal_definitions.t_role_exact: first scheduled checkpoint with ROLE_TEST accuracy == 1.0 at that checkpoint and the next two scheduled checkpoints
temporal_definitions.t_triad_exact: first scheduled checkpoint with all 48 observed triples having all three completions correct at that checkpoint and the next two scheduled checkpoints
